_comment: Parity-only fine-grained admin permission (Keycloak 26 FGAP v2) for the local/ephemeral compose stack. Applied by the parity-admin-permissions service with the identity repo's scripts/realm/apply-admin-permissions.mjs (fetched, not copied), after the identity step and the parity-fixtures import. Same shape as the identity repo's realm/admin-permissions.json; own permission and policy names, so the identity repo's objects are never touched. Never part of the identity repo's realm.

permissions.name: parity-customers-parity-suite
permissions.description: Parity suite (Keycloak mode): view and update members of /customers only, like the customer service. Not staff users, no role or group changes. Ephemeral/local only.
